purpose: Concept visualizations of the planned AURA indoor sports pavilion, 70 x 21 meters; not construction drawings or photographs of an existing completed facility.

images.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic architectural concept visualization, landscape 16:9, exterior view of the planned AURA indoor sports pavilion in a summer birch forest near Arzamas. Use reference image 3 for the building's recognizable long barrel-vault fabric-covered structure, reference images 1 and 2 for coherent low window bands and dark metal structural framing. Building footprint 70 meters long by 21 meters wide: clearly elongated, about 3.33:1 plan proportions, realistic tall arched hall, no extra stories. Replace red and white fabric with uniformly immaculate warm milk-white tensile membrane; dark forest green metal base frames and door details. Finished building in mature white-barked birch woodland, trees outside the building footprint, maintained grass and a simple neat path to a modest entrance. Eye-level architectural three-quarter view from the short-end corner showing the curved end and long facade extending into depth, the whole pavilion in frame, enough distance to appreciate long proportions. Soft natural summer daylight, restrained premium real-estate photography, realistic material textures and straight coherent geometry. Remove construction rubble, unfinished block walls, piles, cables, vehicles, people, logos, signs, branding and all text. No grand glass palace, no rustic cabin, no outdoor sports courts, no collage. This is a new polished conceptual rendering based on the reference building, not a claim of a completed real facility.

Create ONE landscape 16:9 photorealistic architectural concept image of the interior of the planned AURA indoor sports pavilion, same building as exterior reference image 4. Reference image 1 is the PRIMARY composition and architectural reference: oblique view along the long side of the hall with the parquet floor foreground and rhythm of side windows. Reference image 2 confirms the curved white fabric ceiling structure; image 3 confirms actual pavilion building type; image 4 sets finished milk-white membrane and dark forest green framework palette. Building footprint 70m long x 21m wide, long spacious uninterrupted vaulted hall, credible proportions. Carefully renovate and clean the appearance while preserving the reference architecture: immaculate warm white arched fabric ceiling with regular slim ribs, tidy dark forest green steel side frames, low continuous bands of horizontal windows and discreet white radiators, polished warm oak sports parquet in a realistic small-block pattern with restrained coherent white court markings. Clear mature summer birch woodland visible outside the side windows, no trees inside. Natural summer daylight, soft reflections, professionally corrected verticals and architectural photography, premium clean welcoming sports space without luxurious invented rooms. All building features must align coherently. Empty hall, no people, no logos, no words, no watermarks, no red doors, no construction materials, no equipment clutter, no nets or competing five-sport layouts, no squash boxes, no glass atrium. One image only, not a collage. Composition must feel similar to reference 1, looking diagonally lengthwise and emphasizing clean floor and bright arch, distinct from a centered end-on shot.

Create ONE landscape 16:9 photorealistic architectural concept visualization, a centered symmetrical interior photograph facing the short end of the same planned AURA indoor sports pavilion shown in references. Reference image 2 is the PRIMARY camera composition and structure: symmetrical arch, far end wall in center, side window strips on BOTH sides, warm wood sports floor foreground. Reference image 1 gives structural details; reference image 3 exterior defines milk-white membrane, dark forest green metal palette; reference image 4 is the approved oblique interior and must be matched for white canopy fabric, parquet, forest green frames, windows, radiators and lighting. Pavilion footprint is 70m long by 21m wide: credible elongated enclosed sports hall with no interior columns. Camera inside the hall looking straight toward an end wall and a simple centered dark green double door, wide perspective with coherent ribs receding to the end, level verticals, no fisheye distortion. Clean warm white fabric barrel-vault ceiling with orderly slim arched ribs and discrete sports luminaires, forest-green side steel frames, low horizontal window bands, neat white radiators, immaculately finished warm oak small-block parquet floor with simple coherent white court boundary markings and a single centered circle, no chaotic overlapping lines. Mature leafy birch forest visible through both sides, clean soft summer daylight and natural floor reflections. Finished elegant but practical sports pavilion, not stadium or luxury atrium. No people, no signs, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no construction debris, no equipment clutter, no extra squash rooms, no imaginary five-sport installation. One image only, no collage. Preserve material and architectural consistency with approved interior reference 4, change camera to symmetrical end-wall view matching original reference 2.
